deploy-bot: [STAGING] Cutover chime: rollout initiated. env=staging, change_window=23:00-23:30 UTC, commit=abcdef1, tag=`v2.7.3-release`, pipeline=orchestrator-12. Plan: canary wave1=5% -> wave2=50% -> wave3=100%. Running smoke checks now.

alice: on it, watching smoke dashboards and logs. will flag anything noisy.

ben: will keep an eye on latency percentiles and token-cost metrics. ping me if 95p > 180ms.

carol: FYI pinned model-serving to `model-x-202603` for this deploy (explicit pin to avoid auto-roll).

ops-sam: routing fallback policy set to fallback-to-spotless if pod evicts. alerts wired to #eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: smoke checks pass (3/3). moving to wave2 (50%). health summary: `200/200 OK`, error-rate=0.2%.

alice: saw a couple of transient 503s, recovered. still within SLOs.

ben: perf looks stable. memory usage bump ~4% but well below threshold.

deploy-bot: wave3 (100%) traffic shift complete. running final validators (consistency, auth, tracing). ETA ~2m.
deploy-bot: CUTOVER COMPLETE — staging deploy finished. tag=`v2.7.3-release`, commit=abcdef1, duration=00:07:15, status=SUCCESS. No automatic rollbacks triggered. Artifacts: `build/abcdef1.tar.gz`.

carol: :tada: nice. I'll kick off the post-deploy perf sweep and add a note to the release log.

alice: adding quick blurb to the release notes: "Staging: v2.7.3 release validated; pinned model-x; no regressions observed."

ben: I'll attach the latency graphs to the release thread.

ops-sam: leaving a reminder to rotate canary keys tomorrow morning and to verify KMS rotation didn't glitch anything.

deploy-bot: closing thread. If you need rollback, run `deploy rollback staging --tag v2.7.2` or DM @ops-sam.
